mapper.sql: select c.metric_code, c.metric_name, c.value_format, c.value_decimals, c.judge_type, c.min_sample_key, case when c.min_sample_key = 'base' then '基准' else coalesce(s.metric_name, c.min_sample_key) end as min_sample_label, c.min_sample_default, c.allow_negative from dashboard_metric_card c left join dashboard_metric_card s on s.metric_code = c.min_sample_key where c.monitorable = true and (c.status is null or c.status = '0')

select u.user_id, u.email, u.user_type, sr.role_sites from sys_user u left join (select ur.user_id, string_agg(coalesce(nullif(trim(r.site_code), ''), '*'), ',' order by r.role_id) as role_sites from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' group by ur.user_id) sr on sr.user_id = u.user_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and coalesce(u.email, '') <> '' and (u.user_type = '01' or exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and m.status = '0' where ur.user_id = u.user_id and m.perms = 'monitor:rule:list'))
